import re
from collections import Counter

def top_k_frequent_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[str]:
    if k <= 0 or not text:
        return []
    
    # Extract words and count their frequencies case-insensitively
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    word_counts = Counter(words)
    
    # Get the top k most frequent words
    top_k = word_counts.most_common(k)
    
    # Sort by frequency descending and then alphabetically ascending
    top_k.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    
    # Extract the words from the sorted list
    result = [word for word, count in top_k]
    
    return result

import re

def generate_slug(title: str, max_length: int = 50) -> str:
    if not title:
        return ""
    
    # Lowercase all ASCII characters
    title = title.lower()
    
    # Replace any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen '-'
    title = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', title)
    
    # Trim leading and trailing hyphens
    title = title.strip('-')
    
    # If length exceeds max_length, truncate to at most max_length characters
    if len(title) > max_length:
        # Avoid cutting a word in half by snapping back to the previous hyphen
        last_hyphen = title.rfind('-', 0, max_length)
        if last_hyphen != -1:
            title = title[:last_hyphen]
        else:
            title = title[:max_length]
    
    # Strip any trailing hyphen
    title = title.rstrip('-')
    
    return title
